outcome: An account's invoices can be listed in an order the user chooses.

acceptance_criteria.text: Invoices are listed for the requested account.

expected_verification.assertion: listing returns rows scoped to the account

acceptance_criteria.text: A sort column and direction the caller supplies are restricted to a known set before reaching the database.

expected_verification.assertion: a sort column outside the allowed set is refused rather than sent to the database

data_impact: Reads invoices. A crafted sort could read or alter anything the connection can reach.
security_impact: String-built SQL with a caller-controlled fragment is injection, whatever else on the statement is parameterised.
rollback: git revert removes the sort option.
